title: Notes search: all words and result limits
question: How can the inherited notes search find all query words and cap results?

observations: REA recovered a CommonJS source module from search.cjs and retained source ranges and a file digest.
Source lines 3-14 normalize the query, filter archived notes and tags, match substrings, and rank title matches first.
The included Node test record compares both the reference implementation and reconstruction against 10 explicit expected outcomes.
The descendant package preserves the parent search.js digest and calls that implementation from child.js.
Five fresh descendant checks cover separated words, filters and result limits; ten parent cases are rerun against the child.
finding.interpretation: The extension reuses inherited search for the first word and filters remaining words across title plus body. A nonnegative integer limit caps the filtered results. Single-word behavior retains the parent semantics.
limitations: REA static relationships do not prove runtime behavior; the bounded executed cases provide separate behavioral evidence.
Inputs are well-formed notes with string title/body and string-array tags. This does not reproduce arbitrary applications or Unicode normalization.
The public evidence file is a portable excerpt, not the complete original REA bundle.
Multiple words use AND semantics rather than the parent phrase semantics. No controlled model-performance or cost improvement is claimed.

evidence.description: Real REA source-module observation, source digest and limitations; local-machine paths excluded.

requirements: Node.js 24 or newer to rerun the supplied tests
Review files before executing them; no automatic permission is granted
